title: A First Course in Sparse Optimization
summary: This article aims to provide a comprehensive overview of sparse optimization, with a focus on both sparse signal recovery and sparse regularization techniques. We will begin by exploring the foundations of sparse optimization, delving into the mathematical tools and models that underpin sparse signal recovery and LASSO. We will then discuss key algorithms for both sparse recovery (e.g., basis pursuit, matching pursuit) and sparse regularization (e.g., LASSO, elastic net), along with their applications in real-world problems.
